svg.text: ⚡ CloudPulse Platform • GitOps, FinOps & Telemetry Lifecycle

g.text: 🛡️ Step 1: Pre-Merge IaC Security & FinOps Cost Guard
GitHub Actions validates Terraform syntax, scans Trivy misconfigurations, and enforces $250/mo budget.
Pipeline #184: All 4 quality gates green • Commit 3f24a7d • 38s
🔄 Step 2: Argo CD GitOps Continuous Reconciliation
Argo CD watches k8s/base/ on branch main. Self-Heal and Auto-Prune keep cluster matched to Git.
GitOps Policy: selfHeal: true • prune: true • Target: https://kubernetes.default.svc (cloudpulse)
⚡ Step 3: Kubernetes HPA Dynamic Surge Auto-Scaling
Flash-sale simulated surge triggers CPU spike (78% vs 60% target) ➔ HPA rapidly scales pods 2 ➔ 6.
Traffic surged to 300 req/sec • CPU at 78% (Target: 60%)
kubectl get hpa: MIN: 2 • MAX: 6 • REPLICAS: 6 • Restarts: 0 • Probes: /healthz 200 OK
📊 Step 4: Real-Time Grafana Telemetry & SLI Metrics
Prometheus scrapes pod :8000/metrics. Grafana tracks traffic rate, p99 latency, and cluster health.
Prometheus: UP • Scrape Interval: 10s • Dashboard: cloudpulse-prod-telemetry • Alerts Firing: 0
CloudPulse GitOps Platform • AWS EKS v1.31 + Argo CD + Prometheus Stack
